open.belief: If I ask my brother to help me move, then he’ll say he’s busy.
open.test: Text him and ask, in one line.

done.label: A day without checking social media
done.belief: If I go a day without opening the apps I scroll, then I’ll be the only one who hasn’t heard something.
done.x: Someone will mention it and it’ll be obvious I’m out of the loop.
done.test: Go a day without opening the apps you scroll. At the end, write down what you actually missed.
done.drop: No opening one “just to see if anyone’s messaged me”.
done.o: He said fair enough and got his own coffee.

done.label: Sitting still when I feel restless
done.belief: If I sit with the restlessness for ten minutes, then I’ll be no use for the rest of the day.
done.x: I’ll write the day off and get nothing done.
done.test: Sit with the restlessness for ten minutes at the moment you’d normally get up and do something about it.
done.drop: Don’t reach for your phone, don’t get up to a task, and don’t start something else instead.
